sentence: MedlinePlus says diazepam is used to relieve anxiety, to control agitation caused by alcohol withdrawal, to control muscle spasms and stiffness caused by certain nerve disorders and to control seizures.
note: MedlinePlus: oral diazepam prescribed for anxiety, agitation from alcohol withdrawal, muscle spasms/stiffness from certain nerve disorders, seizures.

sentence: The NHS describes diazepam as generally for short-term use, because longer use can cause addiction and withdrawal symptoms.

sentence: MedlinePlus says diazepam, as a benzodiazepine, works by calming abnormal overactivity in the brain.

sentence: NHS inform says tolerance can develop quickly with frequent use.

sentence: The NHS lists feeling drowsy, tired or less alert among the common side effects of diazepam.

sentence: In an emergency, such as a suspected overdose or severe withdrawal, call 999; NHS 111 or the GP can advise urgently; Samaritans on 116 123 is free at any time.
